database: Real SQLite HTTP server; isolated synthetic QA fixtures
map: Real MapLibre/Three.js and actual OpenFreeMap resources via cached responses; no fake map

suites.name: Adventures, photos and admin regression
checks: Public mountain pilot is visibly draft with source elevations and no checkin action
Ordered urban checkpoints persist and reward only completion
Team territory visit changes leaderboard and prevents second daily click
Admin can publish reviewed mountain points and close them via real forms
Admin creates published contest with explicit device-local dates
Real file upload resizes camera image, obtains consent and displays private pending JPEG
Admin approves private image, public gallery displays stripped JPEG and author gains XP
Eligible viewer votes once; competition exposes rank and own vote
Report reaches moderator with exact photo lookup and resolution
Owner withdraws image and file becomes inaccessible
Astana switch uses separate city data and mutation query
Astana admin can update routes and create active zones without cross-city errors
390/320px adventures and eight-item admin navigation have no page overflow

suites.name: Large data, navigation races and pagination
checks: Large quest catalog pages explicitly and server search finds entries beyond first page
Progress totals stay accurate while only one bounded page of fog cells is loaded
Organization catalog uses stable cursor pages and previous page restores the first record
A delayed catalog response cannot overwrite a newer navigation
Photo form displays configured quotas and GPS rules; requesting GPS preserves its draft
Admin independently pages organizations, quests and users with totals and targeted search
Delayed privileged read cannot replace a later public page
Audit integrity runs only on explicit admin action and displays verified snapshot count
Token redemption history pages 50 records without truncating later records
Map viewport caps city organizations and reports that zoom reveals more places
Team-only map updates do not rebuild quest, organization, fog or 3D sources
320px large catalog and management remain within viewport

suites.name: Private photo lifetime and cancellation
checks: Private photo loader fetches visible images lazily and keeps its page concurrency bounded
Leaving the gallery aborts an in-flight private image and releases every object URL

limits: Native operating system builds and real geolocation were not exercised; fixtures use server API locations.
External map resources use a real previously fetched tile cache because direct browser egress is restricted.
